text: Morning all Does anyone have spare hoses they can bring to the site? Two have gone at the back tap and I want them for the Saturday work morning
Morning! Patrick has the van this weekend I think, I'll ask him
He says he can take them Sat if they're at the front gate, the van won't fit down the back lane
Front gate is fine Thank you Sophie
I have one long green one in the shed. It has a split near the end but still works
Bring it along Odile The split can go on the compost side
can i bring the one from my plot?? its fine for what u need im on nights sat so cant do the morning sorry
Yes Thomas, bring it if you can Nobody has to do the morning, just whatever you manage
Patrick says he'll be at the site from 9 Sat if anyone needs a lift with stuff 🚐
Also the water bill came, I'll bring it to the Monday meeting, not urgent
Yes I can do 9. Is the big hose clamp still in the box in the shed?
anyone know if the gate code changed??
